parameters.content:
## 💌 LouLou & Luxe — Newsletter & VIP Waitlist Capture (`Personal > POD > LouLou & Luxe`)
- **Webhook Endpoint:** `POST /webhook/loulou-newsletter-signup`
- **Database Table:** PostgreSQL `loulou_newsletter_subscribers`
- **Instant Notification Email:** Sent via `Gmail 008 SMTP` to **`user@example.com`** whenever anyone signs up on `https://loulouandluxe.com` or `http://localhost:11434`.

nodes.name: 3. Postgres: Save Subscriber & Bind to LouLou & Luxe Folder

parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS loulou_newsletter_subscribers (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  email VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  shopper_role VARCHAR(120) DEFAULT 'Everyday Boutique',
  source_page VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT 'loulouandluxe.com',
  promo_code VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT 'LULLUXE25',
  page_url TEXT DEFAULT '',
  visitor_ip VARCHAR(120) DEFAULT '',
  user_agent TEXT DEFAULT '',
  signup_count INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

INSERT INTO loulou_newsletter_subscribers (
  email, shopper_role, source_page, promo_code, page_url, visitor_ip, user_agent, signup_count, created_at, updated_at
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.safeEmail }}',
  '{{ $json.role }}',
  '{{ $json.source }}',
  '{{ $json.promoCode }}',
  '{{ $json.pageUrl }}',
  '{{ $json.ip }}',
  '{{ $json.ua }}',
  1,
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET
  shopper_role = EXCLUDED.shopper_role,
  source_page = EXCLUDED.source_page,
  promo_code = EXCLUDED.promo_code,
  page_url = EXCLUDED.page_url,
  visitor_ip = EXCLUDED.visitor_ip,
  user_agent = EXCLUDED.user_agent,
  signup_count = loulou_newsletter_subscribers.signup_count + 1,
  updated_at = NOW();

UPDATE workflow_entity
SET "parentFolderId" = 'loulouLuxeSub001'
WHERE name LIKE 'LouLou & Luxe — Newsletter & VIP Waitlist Capture%'
  AND ("parentFolderId" IS NULL OR "parentFolderId" <> 'loulouLuxeSub001');

SELECT
  '{{ $json.safeEmail }}' AS subscriber_email,
  '{{ $json.role }}' AS shopper_role,
  '{{ $json.source }}' AS source_page,
  '{{ $json.promoCode }}' AS promo_code,
  '{{ $json.pageUrl }}' AS page_url,
  '{{ $json.ip }}' AS visitor_ip,
  '{{ $json.signedUpAt }}' AS signed_up_at,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loulou_newsletter_subscribers) AS total_subscribers;
